sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 1008 of 2024

Petitioner :- Mohit Kakkar And Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secrt. Lko. And Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Satendra Kumar Singh,Paresh Kumar Singh Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,D.K. Singh Somvanshi Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
None appears on behalf of the petitioners to press this petition whereas learned AGA is present.

This writ petition has been filed witha prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing of First Information Report dated 1.1.2024 registered as Case Crime No.
0001 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 354 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act at Police Station-Mahila Thana, District Kheri and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners pursuant to the impugned FIR.
Learned AGA, on the basis of his instructions, states that the charge sheet is already prepared and Mohit Kakkar And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 10 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14381961/
1 submitted in Court on 19.2.2024 for approval of the same.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, liberty is granted to the petitioners to move an appropriate application raising all their grievances before the appropriate court, who shall look into the matter and pass an order in accordance with law.

With the aforesaid direction, writ petition is disposed off.
.
(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 10.7.2024
